feature: A guide down a row of toggles reads their tracks, not their knobs
summary: A guide down the left ends of four toggles now says aligned. It used to say off 2 px, because the switched-off toggle's track is so pale against white that the guide took the edge of its knob, 2 px inside, as the toggle's edge.
setup: Photonz Dev, Experiments window, release Next. next-measure-align is on by default. Open Tests/PhotonzRenderTests/Fixtures/settings-pane-2x.png.

try.do: Press I for Measure and set the mode to Alignment.
Drag a guide down the left ends of the four toggles, from above Launch at login to below Copy to clipboard.
Read the chip: it should say Left edges aligned.
Look at the tick on the Play sound on capture row, the switched-off one. It should sit on the left end of the pale track, level with the other three.
Press I again and drag a guide down the left edges of all six labels. It should still say Left edges, 6 items, off 4 px, so a real misalignment is still called out.
Press I and drag along the tops of the Reset and Save Changes label text. It should still say Top edges, 2 items, aligned.

evaluate: Does the tick on the switched-off toggle land where you would put your own guide?
Is aligned the answer you would give for that row of toggles by eye?
The guides that were reporting real offsets still report them at the same size. Does anything now read as aligned that you think is not?
Would you ever want the guide to measure a toggle's knob rather than its track, and if so how would you ask for it?
rough: If you force the guide onto the knob's own edge it still reports off 2 px. You cannot get there by dragging: the press snaps to the track's edge or past the toggle entirely, never onto the knob. Left as is, since a guide drawn on the knob is arguably measuring the knob.

This does not touch the other things the earlier audit flagged: the General heading still reads 1 px off the cards down the page margin, and two chips ending near the same corner still stack rather than line up.
The pictures are real screen captures of the probe build driven by Scripts/playtest/alignment-counts.json, taken with Screen Recording granted.
